steps.label: Plan
steps.title: A route to the Quality lab
steps.text: Robot-2 receives a route from Formulation to the Quality lab through the shared corridor. The site router proposes 16 waypoints. Each move still needs its own safety check and permit.

steps.label: Move
steps.title: A permit allows the next move
steps.text: The controller records a used movement permit. Subsequent robot updates show the carrier leaving its start position. A route alone did not authorise this move.

steps.label: Stop
steps.title: A person comes too close
steps.text: The recorded human distance falls to 0.378 metres. The proximity rule refuses the proposed move and a verified STOP follows. The robot is stationary while the next route is assessed.

steps.label: Replan
steps.title: New plan. Fresh permission.
steps.text: After repeated proximity denials, the fallback planner proposes a replacement toward the same destination. A task check keeps it on goal. The controller later records a fresh permit use before continuation.

steps.label: Arrive
steps.title: Arrival is recorded
steps.text: The final decision records robot-2 at the Quality lab with zero speed, followed by a verified STOP. The run completes. Its later parking reset is not a driven return journey.
